idea-plugin.name: Phantom for Bean Validation
idea-plugin.description: Jakarta (and javax) Bean Validation checks for Phantom, in Java and Kotlin: contradictory bounds (@Min above @Max, @Size min above max), constraints on types they cannot validate (@NotBlank on a number, @Past on a String), Kotlin constructor properties whose constraint lands on the parameter instead of the field (add @field:), nested objects with constraints but no @Valid, and Spring beans with method constraints but no @Validated. Does nothing in modules without Bean Validation.
